# coolify_instance (Data Source)

Health and version of the Coolify instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_instance" "this" {}

output "coolify_version" {
  value = data.coolify_instance.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `healthy` (Boolean) Whether `/health` answers OK.
- `version` (String) Coolify version (e.g. `4.3.3`).
